sources.title: Unsloth - Run and Train Models Locally
sources.snippet: Start Unsloth, load a model, open your project folder, then run unsloth start claude. Swap models in Unsloth without changing your agent workflow. Unsloth also exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, so existing apps, scripts and SDKs can connect to your local models through a familiar interface.
